title: Daily API Digest to Slack
summary: Pull records from any JSON API, summarise them, and post a digest to Slack on a schedule.
trigger: Manual run, or attach a daily schedule in Studio
seoTitle: Daily API Digest to Slack with AI Summaries
answer: This template fetches records from any JSON API endpoint with bearer authentication, uses an AI agent to summarize counts and key changes into a short written digest, then posts the digest to a Slack channel. The workflow retries API calls up to 5 times with exponential backoff, and you can attach a daily schedule in Studio to automate morning digests for your team.

faq.q: Can Slack or workflow tools do this natively?
faq.a: Slack can receive webhook posts and Zapier or Make can pull API data on a schedule, but they do not include AI summarization that turns raw JSON into a readable digest. This template combines API fetching, LLM summarization and Slack posting in one workflow.

faq.q: What JSON APIs does this work with?
faq.a: Any public or private JSON API that accepts bearer token authentication and returns a JSON array or object. Edit the fetch_data step if your API requires query parameters, custom headers, or a different auth method.

faq.q: How do I customize the digest format?
faq.a: Edit the summarize step code to change how the AI agent processes the JSON records. You can add filters, groupings, or custom formatting before the text is sent to Slack.

faq.q: What happens if the API call fails?
faq.a: The fetch_data step retries up to 5 times with exponential backoff starting at 500ms. If all retries fail, the workflow stops and logs the error. No digest is posted to Slack.

faq.q: Can I post to multiple Slack channels?
faq.a: The template posts to one channel per run. To post to multiple channels, duplicate the post_digest step and set a different SLACK_DIGEST_CHANNEL secret, or extend the workflow to loop over a list of channels.

sampleOutput: Slack message in #ops: Daily Digest for Nov 19: 47 new records, 12 updated. Top change: Acme Corp upgraded to Enterprise. 3 records flagged for review.
whatYouNeed: JSON API endpoint URL and bearer token for that API, Slack Bot integration connected and invited to digest channel
failureHandling: The HTTP fetch step retries up to 5 times with exponential backoff starting at 500ms. If it fails after all retries, the workflow stops and logs the error. Scheduling continues on the next trigger.
nativeVsTemplate: Use a no-code automation tool like Zapier when you only need to post raw API data to Slack without transformation. Use this template when you want AI-powered summarization that turns JSON records into readable insights, with built-in retries and scheduling.

secrets.name: DIGEST_API_URL
secrets.description: Full URL of the JSON endpoint to read, without the query string.

setup: Connect the Slack Bot integration in Ballet once and invite the bot to your digest channel.
Update the fetch_data step with your API URL and authentication method (the template defaults to bearer token).
Run the playbook once manually to check the digest.
Set up a daily schedule using an external scheduler or cron job to trigger the playbook via API, or use Ballet's scheduling feature if available.
